summary.headline: Mars Combustion in Triplicities
summary.text: Astrological effects of Mars’s combustion in the fiery triplicity and other triplicities, including warfare, political unrest, disease, drought, floods, trade, weather, and dangers to travelers. Nasir al-Milla wa al-Din’s Safina is cited for broader omens, with modifying influences from Saturn, Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, and the Moon.
